SItanIreNa SItalapAnIyena plAvitairAloDitaiH | eke plAvitaiH SItanIreNetyasya sthAne ``plAvitaiH SarkarAtoyaiH'' iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | punaH kIdRuSaiH ? saGRutaiH uktaparimANaGRutayuktaiH | kathaMBUtaiH ? nAtisAndradravai: nAtiSayena sAndradravAstairiti | sAndraM kaThinaM, dravaM toyasadRuSam | tathAca tantrAntare ``saktavaH sarpiShAByaktAH SItavAripariplutAH | nAtidravA nAtisAndrA mantha ityaBidhIyate'' | eke ``nAtisAndrairdravairmantha'' iti paThanti | tanmate tu sAndratvaM niShiddhaM dravatvaM praSastamiti | tathAca matAntare vAkyadvayamAha ``gurvI piNDI KarAtyarthaM laGvI saiva viparyayAt | na jalAntIratAn dviH saktUnadyAnna kevalAn'' iti drave~api sAPalyamanugrAhakena darSayitumAha | tadyathA ``pItAH satarpaNA hRudyAH sadyo balavivardhanAH | vAtAtapAdhvavyAyAmakarSitAnAM SramApahA || madhurA laGavaH SItAH saktavo raktapittahA iti | ayamapi SarkarAdisaMyuktaH kartavyo vyavahArAt | uktaM ca ``SarkarekShumadhudrAkShAyukta: pitta- vikAranut | drAkShAmadhusamAyuktaH kaParogaharaH smRutaH || vargatrayeNopahito maladoShAnulomanaH iti ||11 || 12|| iti SrIvAstavyAnvabaprakASavaidyaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAM madhyaKaNDe PANTa- kalpanA nAma tRutIyo~adhyAyaH || 3 ||
